author: Arigenn
body:
Hello Avicus,

The Map Development team is looking for as many ways to improve as possible. We would like to see what exactly the community would like us to improve in. This will ultimately help the whole team to be better map developers, there's always room for improvement!

Please leave what you believe should be improved in the map developing team of Avicus, and please don't clutter the comments with useless messages.

replies.body:
More Encouragement to play In other gamemodes

Maps need more variety. All maps should be unique to one another so when you play them, they will be different from ones another.

replies.body:
+1

Same for map names that don't say what the map will be like. A map name should reflect on the map so it's easier to remember what the map looks like.

(Example: Tetris Swamp. Tetris Swamp just calls out "Swamp" when you think of it so it's easier to remember what the map is about)

replies.author: JohnYoYo9
replies.body: I'd like to focus on the uniqueness as of now, but probably as a more defined suggestion; even more creative and outside the box maps to improve the in-game aspects. I like to notice and use the little things, tiny easter eggs, cool weapons, etc. Just things to make a map stand out more than the other maps, in more literal terms; I think there should be more focus on smaller things and not always the big picture, you need a common balance between both pillars of excellent map creation, though. I'm sure my opinion of maps may not be as highly regarded as someone who makes them, but I'm just saying this due to I have a bad computer so in some cases actually fighting and objectively playing may not be the most enjoyable destination, but with other little side activities and little buffs found around the map makes it more enjoyable for me.
